language.title: Choose your language · Vyberte si jazyk

intro.title: Let's set up your kitchen
intro.body: We'll ask a few quick questions about how you cook and shop. It only takes a couple of minutes, but dapcook will be easier to use afterwards.
intro.settingsNote: Don't worry, you can change everything later in Settings.

household.title: Name your household
household.help: This is the shared space for your recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.

translation.title: Translate recipes?
translation.help: When you import a recipe written in another language, dapcook can translate it for you.

units.title: Which units do you use?
units.help: Imported recipes are converted to your units.

tags.title: What kind of recipes will you add?
tags.help: In dapcook you'll save recipes — from the web, cookbooks or your own. Tags keep them organized, so later you can quickly find, say, all your soups or vegan dishes. Just pick a few that make sense to you — you can add more anytime.

shoppingCategories.title: Shopping categories
shoppingCategories.help: Your shopping list is grouped and ordered by these categories. Arrange them like the aisles of your usual supermarket — drag to reorder, use the pencil to rename.

shoppingRules.title: Shopping rules
shoppingRules.help: When dapcook builds your shopping list with AI, it follows these rules. Use them to merge similar items or leave out things you always have at home.
shoppingRules.examplesLabel: Tap an example to add it:

done.title: You're all set!
done.body: Start by adding your first recipe.
